name: build-and-test
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-ubuntu:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
         transform: [fftw, kiss_fft]
         cc: [gcc, clang]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libmagickwand-7.q16-dev libfftw3-dev libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev curl gawk libcmocka-dev
      - name: Configure resdet with FFTW
        if: matrix.transform == 'fftw'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Configure resdet with KISSFFT
        if: matrix.transform == 'kiss_fft'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --disable-fftw
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
            CFLAGS: -Wno-invalid-feature-combination
      - name: Build resdet
        run: make
      - name: Install resdet
        run: sudo make install install-lib
      - name: Install bash_unit
        run: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bash-unit/bash_unit/master/install.sh | bash
      - name: Set up python binding tests
        run: make .testvenv
      - name: Run tests
        run: make check
      - name: Run resdet
        run: resdet -v0 test/files/blue_marble_2012_resized.pfm
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
         transform: [fftw, kiss_fft]
         cc: [gcc-15, clang]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew update
          brew install fftw imagemagick ffmpeg gawk cmocka bash_unit #libpng and libjpeg are already installed
      - name: Configure resdet with FFTW
        if: matrix.transform == 'fftw'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Configure resdet with KISSFFT
        if: matrix.transform == 'kiss_fft'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --disable-fftw
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Build resdet
        run: make
      - name: Install resdet
        run: |
          sudo mkdir /usr/local/include /usr/local/lib
          sudo make install install-lib
      - name: Set up python binding tests
        run: make .testvenv
      - name: Run tests
        run: make check
      - name: Run resdet
        run: resdet -v0 test/files/blue_marble_2012_resized.pfm
  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
         transform: [fftw, kiss_fft]
         cc: [gcc, clang]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: msys2 {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: UCRT64
          update: true
          install: mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-clang pkg-config make curl mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libpng mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libjpeg-turbo mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-imagemagick mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-ffmpeg gawk mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-cmocka mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-pip mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-numpy mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-pillow mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-python-pytest
      - name: Configure resdet with FFTW
        if: matrix.transform == 'fftw'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared --prefix=/ucrt64 --libprefix=/ucrt64/bin
        env:
            CC: ${{matrix.cc}}
      - name: Configure resdet with KISSFFT
        if: matrix.transform == 'kiss_fft'
        run: ./configure --enable-shared

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
